description: Add a website to your Cookie Free Analytics account so you can start seeing its visitors, without a cookie banner. Give the address, like example.com. If the site is already in your account you get that one back instead of a duplicate. Returns the site id; next, call get_tracking_script to get the one line to paste on the site. Needs the ‘Add websites’ permission. Free Hobby accounts can have 3 websites. Available on Hobby (free) and paid plans.

domain.description: The website address, for example example.com or shop.example.com. https:// and paths are ignored.

name.description: Optional friendly name shown in the dashboard.

name: add_website
title: Add a website
